import numpy as np

def transform(grid):
    a=np.array(grid,dtype=int)
    h,w=a.shape
    # Find a full-length straight divider of color 2.
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if np.all(a[r,:]==2)]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if np.all(a[:,c]==2)]
    if rows:
        axis=0; line=rows[0]
    elif cols:
        axis=1; line=cols[0]
    else:
        return a.tolist()
    bg=int(np.bincount(a.ravel()).argmax())
    coords=np.argwhere((a!=bg)&(a!=2))
    if len(coords)==0: return a.tolist()
    # Shape lies on one side of divider; translate until it touches it.
    lo=int(coords[:,axis].min()); hi=int(coords[:,axis].max())
    if hi < line:  # object before line: move forward
        delta=line-1-hi
        near=lo+delta
        mark=near-1
    elif lo > line: # object after line: move backward
        delta=line+1-lo
        near=hi+delta
        mark=near+1
    else:
        delta=0; mark=None
    out=np.full_like(a,bg)
    # preserve divider
    if axis==0: out[line,:]=2
    else: out[:,line]=2
    # Translate all foreground points.
    for r,c in coords:
        if axis==0: nr=int(r+delta); nc=int(c)
        else: nr=int(r); nc=int(c+delta)
        if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w: out[nr,nc]=int(a[r,c])
    # Add the contrasting parallel line on the far side of the translated object.
    if mark is not None and 0<=mark<(h if axis==0 else w):
        if axis==0: out[mark,:]=8
        else: out[:,mark]=8
    return out.tolist()

test=[[5]*22 for _ in range(18)]
for r in [7,8,9,10,11,12]:
    pass
# enter observed shape cells
for r,cs in {7:[13],8:[11,13],9:[10,12,14],10:[9,10,11,12],11:[10,11,13,14],12:[11,12,14]}.items():
    for c in cs:test[r][c]=7
for c in range(22):test[15][c]=2
res=transform(test)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in res))
